summary: Bitterroot NF crow's nest and camp near Lost Trail Pass, dated 1941; listed abandoned, one page says still there; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Crow's nest and camp (1941); Montana Lookouts calls it a tree lookout
facts.status_note: FFLA index lists Abandoned; firelookout.com says Still there without detail; no source says gone

events.note: Crow's nest and camp listed under 1941
Abandoned in the 1940s; the page gives no single year

evidence.supports: About 10 miles north-northeast of Lost Trail Pass
evidence.quote: 10 miles NNE of Lost Trail Pass

evidence.supports: FFLA index lists Hilltop as Abandoned
Agency is the Bitterroot National Forest

corrections.why: The FFLA Montana index I read lists Hilltop as Crowsnest Abandoned, and firelookout.com says Still there. Neither source says gone. The brief's conflict note says ffla=gone, which I did not find on the index page; check the individual FFLA page before setting a final status.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says Still there; the FFLA index says Abandoned. Not resolved; the story says the two sources describe the site differently and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. firelookout.com gives a 1941 crow's nest and camp, abandonment in the 1940s and 'Still there' with no detail; the FFLA index says Abandoned; the Montana Lookouts entry gives only agency and type. The brief's 'gone' is not supported by any page I read. The Rex's Fire Lookout Page linked from the Montana Lookouts entry was not read because of the page budget; it may hold the history and the current condition. Story is about 120 words.
